title: Academic Writing Checkpoint State
description: Unified checkpoint schema for academic-coursework, academic-journal, and academic-thesis modules.

module.description: Which skill module owns this checkpoint.

current_stage.description: Active pipeline stage ID, e.g. C3, S4, T2.

stage_progress.description: What has been done so far within current_stage, in one sentence.

completed_sections.description: List of completed output section/file names.

pending_sections.description: Sections that still need to be written or processed.

outputs.description: Map of stage output keys to file paths relative to paper_dir.

next_action.description: Human-readable instruction for the next step to take on resume.

passport.description: Optional snapshot of key pipeline passport fields at checkpoint time.

revision_round.description: Current revision round number, for convergence loops.

quality_gates.description: Gate check history — which gates have been passed or failed.

_checkpoint_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of checkpoint save. Managed by StateManager.
